text:
Meera: Hey team — customer (FinReg Corp) asked for a tight POC success checklist before we kick off next week. Can we align on acceptance KPIs (latency/cost/quality) + any enterprise blockers?

Ben: Quick summary from last sync: target 4-week POC, 10k monthly active users simulated, endpoints for chat + embeddings. They care about 95th pctl latency, token cost, and QA pass rate on a 150-prompt eval set.

Alex: For latency I'd propose 95th <= 250ms for short-chat flows (<=128 tokens) and < 500ms for long-chain (<=1k tokens). Is that acceptable?

Meera: Customer asked for <=200ms 95th for short flows. Is that realistic without dedicated capacity?

Ben: On hosted we can usually hit ~200-300ms 95th on a3/gpu with batching tuned. If they need strict 200ms we should recommend Dedicated or a pinned low-latency variant + prefix cache. We should call that out in runbook.

Carol: Acceptance thresholds we should propose in doc: 
- Latency: 95th <= 250ms (hosted) / <=200ms (dedicated SLA)
- Error rate: <1% 5xx + model failures
- Quality: human eval pass rate >=85% on developer-defined prompt set; automated metrics (EM/F1) >= baseline (we need baseline from customer)
- Cost: upper bound $X per 1k tokens (TBD with pricing)

Jamie: On quality: ask them to provide ~150 representative prompts and expected outputs or golden labels. We'll run our eval harness and share a Delta report (regressions + hallucination cases).

Ben: Example eval command we plan to run: 
```
python evaluate.py --model redwood-2x --prompts samples/finreg_prompts.jsonl --metrics em,f1,exact_match --save results/finreg_eval.json
```

Meera: Security & compliance checklist: they requested VPC peering + customer-managed KMS + SOC2 evidence. Any blockers?

Alex: Private deployment (VPC) is available but needs legal + infra timelines ~3 weeks to provision. KMS integration requires key rotation policy confirmation. We should surface this as a gating item in the SOW.

Carol: Also verify data retention and delete-on-demand. For POC we can set short retention and explicit logging turned off. Add SSO (SAML) user mapping for their engineers.

Meera: Pricing question from procurement: is there a short-term reserved discount for a 4-week POC if they commit to a pilot conversion?

Ben: We can offer a small pilot discount (10-15%) and credits for eval tooling. If they sign for Dedicated after POC we can convert credits. Exact numbers need salesops sign-off.

Jamie: Operational acceptance: SLA for uptime during POC (we can commit to 99.5% for Dedicated/pilot), runbook for fallbacks (route to smaller model variant), and mutation of eval prompts if we see distribution shift.

Meera: Blockers list to confirm with customer before kick: 
• SSO/SAML details + admin contact
• KMS setup or approval for our KMS integration
• Test dataset (150 prompts) and golden labels
• Confirmation on latency SLA preference (hosted vs dedicated)
• PO/SOW sign-off and legal review timeline

Ben: I'll draft the POC success doc with targets and the eval plan. Sending a first pass by EOD. @Alex can you add infra estimates?

Alex: Yep — will add expected GPU sizing, warmup/cold-start numbers, and expected cost range.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: create-temp-vpc-for-poc in progress — ETA 72h (automated note).

Meera: Perfect. Once Ben drops the doc I'll loop in customer and legal. Thanks :thumbsup:
